headline: Oil Rebounds as Houthi Attacks on Saudi Targets Stoke Supply Fears
summary: Crude oil prices reversed earlier declines, with Brent reaching $92.67 and WTI hitting $83.06 per barrel following reports of fresh Houthi strikes on Saudi targets and ongoing tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Crude benchmarks are highly sensitive to geopolitical conflict and shipping security near Persian Gulf transit chokepoints, which can quickly disrupt global petroleum flows.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Attacks on Saudi infrastructure and tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz raise concerns over crude availability.
